text:
Thank you for your message. We will respond to your enquiry in a timely manner within 10 working days (or sooner if you are booking an appointment in the next 10 days).


The Archive is open 10:00-16:30 Wednesdays-Fridays (except on bank holidays) and the second Saturday of each month. If you wish to view original archive material, we recommend you book in advance via: https://catalogue.postalmuseum.org/ (you must be signed in), or by email.


With kind regards,


TPM Archive Team


Did you know we're a charity? There are lots of ways you can get involved in our work. To find out more visit: www.postalmuseum.org/support-us<http://www.postalmuseum.org/support-us>
